# Tiny Steps Learning

## Overview
Tiny Steps Learning is a premium online English learning school for children.
Domain: https://tinystepslearning.com
Public sitemap/canonical host currently used in repository sitemap files: https://tinystepslearning.com

Tiny Steps Learning provides online English programs for children with one-on-one and small-group online classes. The focus includes structured phonics, synthetic phonics principles, reading confidence, grammar foundations, sentence formation, and communication confidence.

## Core Programs
- Online phonics classes for kids
- Online grammar and sentence-building classes for kids
- Online communication and public speaking classes for kids

## Who It Helps
- Children who need guided support in reading, grammar, speaking, and confidence-building
- Parents who want clear learning continuity and parent progress updates

## Teaching Approach
- Structured phonics instruction built on synthetic phonics principles
- Step-by-step reading development to improve reading confidence
- Grammar and sentence-building practice for stronger sentence formation
- Communication and public speaking practice for communication confidence
- One-on-one and small-group online classes
- Ongoing parent progress updates
